entries.title: About Sharan
entries.text: Sharan S is a B.Tech AI/ML student at Amity University Bengaluru, graduating in May 2027, and Technical Lead at Quickoo. He cares most about agents that do real work on real hardware: an Android agent powered by Gemma that taps through actual apps, and a Bluetooth mesh that keeps phones talking with no internet. On the backend he builds with Python and FastAPI and designs deterministic pipelines that put an LLM behind validation instead of trusting it blindly. He learns codebases by fixing them: 27 of his pull requests have been merged into 14 open-source projects, including NVIDIA Megatron-LM and moto.

entries.title: agent-phone-app
entries.text: A Gemma-first Android agent that operates ordinary phone apps, browser flows, and system screens. Stack: Kotlin · Android · Gemma. Highlights: Visible execution trace for every step the agent takes; Safety checks and confirmations before sensitive actions; Hybrid inference: on-device Gemma plus an optional laptop relay; Targets Android 12–14; PR-only delivery into main with required CI, emulator, and dependency-scan checks.

entries.title: bluetooth-manet-android
entries.text: Nearby phone chat over Bluetooth. No internet, no pairing, no account. Stack: Kotlin · Java · Jetpack Compose · Bluetooth LE / RFCOMM. Highlights: BitChat-style BLE mesh between Android phones; a Windows laptop can join over classic Bluetooth; Multi-hop relaying with TTL forwarding: A reaches C through B automatically; Messages and files are signed so relays cannot undetectably tamper with them (they are not end-to-end encrypted); Current release v1.4.4 · min SDK 21 · target SDK 34.

entries.title: kosh
entries.text: Offline-first personal finance and bill splitting. Stack: Flutter · Dart · Firebase. Highlights: Private ledger with budgets, insights, goals, and forecasts; Friends and groups with equal, exact, percentage, and item splits in paise; Deterministic balances and min-cash-flow settlements; Settle up through UPI / Google Pay; a client UPI response is never treated as proof of payment; Firebase Auth with email, Google Sign-In, and guest mode.

entries.title: swarm-coder-universal
entries.text: A leaderless, verifiable, fault-tolerant coding swarm. No central orchestrator. Stack: TypeScript · Docker. Highlights: 5 agents in a full mesh; every decision is signed with Ed25519; 3 of 5 signatures required, so it survives 2 simultaneous agent failures; Recovers in under 5 seconds; about 45 tasks per minute; Task owner is computed independently by every agent: hash(task_id + vertex_seq) % alive_agents; Switch domains (coding, medical, education) by editing prompts, not code.

entries.title: HackerRank-Orchestrator
entries.text: Cortex Notify: a deterministic, memory-aware WhatsApp notification router. Stack: Python 3.12 · Polars · Docker. Highlights: Decides notify, digest, or mute for every message, with type, explanation, confidence, and evidence IDs; Pipeline: repositories → context → personalization → retrieval → features → priority & risk → decision packet → router agent → validation → CSV; The router agent only ever sees an immutable DecisionPacket, never raw data; Every decision is validated, with a safe fallback.

entries.title: isro-bah-challenge9-shwfs
entries.text: Shack-Hartmann wavefront reconstruction pipeline for ISRO BAH Challenge 9. Stack: Python · PyTorch · ONNX · TensorRT. Highlights: Simulates noisy Shack-Hartmann focal-spot images; OPD-Net style Zernike coefficient reconstruction; ONNX export and a TensorRT FP16 engine for deployment.

entries.title: CognyxOS
entries.text: An AI agent runtime and desktop environment that runs on top of Linux, Windows, or macOS. It is not a bootable OS. Stack: Python · React · TypeScript · gRPC · QEMU/KVM. Highlights: Framework for building and orchestrating AI agents; React desktop for monitoring and controlling agents; Python wrappers for QEMU/KVM virtual machine management; Capability layer over Protocol Buffers / gRPC, configured with YAML.

entries.title: drapesense
entries.text: Scan a fabric swatch with your phone camera and see its fabric type, drape, garment previews, yardage, and cutting diagrams. Stack: JavaScript · Groq API. Highlights: Mobile-first single-page web app; Fabric analysis through the Groq API; Garment flats and cutting diagrams for a shirt, trousers, and a wrap dress.

entries.title: plot-ledger
entries.text: A shared ownership ledger: several people record what they paid toward a shared purchase, and each contributor share is their payments divided by all contributors payments, using integer paise and largest-remainder rounding. Google sign-in with admin approval, role-based access in Firestore rules, gesture navigation, and an Android app built with Capacitor that updates itself over the air from GitHub releases with checksum verification and rollback. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Firebase Auth and Firestore, Capacitor, GitHub Actions CI/CD with Playwright and rules tests.

entries.title: Shard (this portfolio)
entries.text: This website: a chatbot-first portfolio with Pitts, the assistant (named after Walter Pitts of the 1943 McCulloch–Pitts neuron), plus Shard, a browser desktop OS (windows, dock, terminal, file system mirrored from GitHub), a One UI-inspired phone OS, and a Three.js 3D retro computer you can click to enter the OS. The name Shard is SHARan + the D of Devil1716. Vanilla JavaScript, no build step.

entries.title: How he thinks about agents
